The Menu

Favorites from the grill

The dishes Dallas keeps coming back for — made to order, day and night.

Quesabirria

Crispy, cheese-filled birria tacos with a rich consommé on the side for dipping — the one everyone talks about.

House Favorite

Enchiladas Suizas

Rolled tortillas covered in a creamy tomatillo sauce and melted cheese, baked until bubbling.

Comfort Classic

Pambazos

The Mexico City street sandwich — bread dipped in guajillo sauce and griddled, filled and topped with crema and lettuce.

Street Style

Grilled Steak Salad

Grilled steak served over fresh, crisp greens — a lighter plate with the same Guerrero flavor.

Fresh & Light

Churros

Golden and crisp, rolled in cinnamon sugar. The sweet finish every late-night run deserves.

Our Story

A neighborhood torteria with late-night hours

Tortas Guerrero — Torteria Guerrero — is a Mexican restaurant on Webb Chapel Ext in Dallas, TX, known for quesabirria, pambazos and some of the latest kitchen hours in the neighborhood. Sunday through Thursday we're here until midnight — and on Friday and Saturday nights, we keep cooking until 4 AM.
